extracted.name: Easy chicken casserole
extracted.description: This flavoursome, low-fat chicken casserole is easy to make and freezes really well, so why not make double and freeze for speedy midweek meals?
ingredient_lines: 400g boneless, skinless chicken thigh trimmed and cut into chunks
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a large pan, add the chicken, then fry until lightly browned. Add the veg, then fry for a few mins more. Stir in the herbs and stock. Bring to the boil. Stir well, reduce the heat, then cover and cook for 40 mins, until the chicken is tender.
Stir the beans into the pan, then simmer for 5 mins. Stir in the parsley and serve with crusty bread.
